---
title: "A language class that is not the first class"
filters:
  - code-window
format:
  html: default
  typst:
    keep-typ: true
---

Pandoc highlights a block with the first class it knows as a language, which
need not be the first class. The window is named after that same class.

```{.terminal .bash}
echo terminal
```

```{.numberLines .bash}
echo numbered
```

A block with line numbers and no language keeps its line numbers. Its window is
named after its first class that does not turn on line numbers.

```{.numberLines}
x = 1
```

```{.numberLines .foo}
x = 2
```
